items.name: Convert's Scale-Pendant
items.lore: A dragon scale on a cord, the drakulv's holy sign. Bjorn wore it.

items.name: Halla's Hunting Cloak
items.lore: Bearskin, from a bear Halla killed at fourteen.

items.name: Sacrificer's Knife-Ring
items.lore: A drakulv sacrificer's ring, its blade-edge filed down.

items.name: Bjorn's Prayer-Belt
items.lore: Knotted with prayers to a dragon. Bjorn says the knots still work, whoever you pray to.

items.name: Svartalf-Steel Bracer
items.lore: Norse steel, svartalf-forged. Better than Svein's. Don't tell him.

items.name: Hammerhand's Ring
items.lore: Svein's mark, the hammer and anvil, stamped in silver.

items.name: Alchemist's Phial-Belt
items.lore: A svartalf alchemist's belt, hung with empty phials.

items.name: Foister's Cloak
items.lore: A svartalf foister's cloak: it makes whatever you carry look like something else.

items.name: Bloodbinder Torc
items.lore: A svartalf bloodbinder's torc. Something written inside it keeps trying to be read.

items.name: Road-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: Iron, the volur's knot on it.

items.name: Missionary-Robe Sash
items.lore: Red cloth, the dragon's eye cut out of it.

items.name: Patrol-Breaker's Bracer
items.lore: Scale-plated, taken off a drakulv.

items.name: Convert's Return Charm
items.lore: A little wooden hammer. Bjorn carved it.

items.name: Infiltrator's Shadow Ring
items.lore: Black glass. You can't see your hand through it.

items.name: Foist-Watcher's Cloak
items.lore: Grey, for lying still.

items.name: Bloodbinder's Rune-Torc
items.lore: Dragon-runes on dark iron - broken.

items.name: Blood-Ward Bracer
items.lore: The volur's knot over the svartalf's runes.

items.name: Scale-Price Ring
items.lore: Paid for in scale. Yours now.

items.name: Varg-Scale Belt
items.lore: Scaled varg hide, very tough.

items.name: Snarler-Fang Ring
items.lore: A varg's fang, set in bronze.

items.name: Armguard's Scale Bracer
items.lore: A drakulv armguard's bracer, the scale still warm.

items.name: Line-Breaker's Torc
items.lore: Iron, hammered flat with an axe-head.

items.name: Sacrificer's Rite-Knife Charm
items.lore: A knife of red scale, the edge dulled now.

items.name: Oath-Keeper's Mantle
items.lore: Volur grey, the Oath's knot on the back.

items.name: Rite-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: Silver, cut with the volur's runes.

items.name: Protector's Scale Ring
items.lore: Red scale in black iron.

items.name: Temple-Step Belt
items.lore: Scorched leather, scale-studded.

items.name: Soultrapper's Gem Charm
items.lore: A gem with something moving in it. Don't look too long.

items.name: Disciple-Breaker's Bracer
items.lore: Volur silver over drakulv scale.

items.name: Volva's Ward-Mantle
items.lore: Grey wool, nine knots on the hem.

items.name: Dragon-Oath Ring
items.lore: The Oath, in silver. You swore it.

items.name: Lair-Road Belt
items.lore: Huscarl leather, scorched.
